resources.string: Adds a Jellyfin folder to Your Library, under Local Files: sign in to your own Jellyfin server and play its music library. Songs stream as their original files, so albums play gapless.
Sign in to your Jellyfin server to play its music library.
This address is not encrypted (http): your password and music cross the network as they are. Fine at home; use https over the internet.
The server could not be reached. Check its address and that your phone is on the same network.
The server refused the user name or password. Sign in again.
This user has no music library on the server.
No crossfade between songs that follow each other on the same album: live records and continuous mixes play on with no gap and no fade.
